WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'cash_withdrawal'
                 THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS cash_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'credit_card_withdrawal'
                 THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS credit_card_total
    FROM transactions
)
SELECT
    cash_total,
    credit_card_total,
    CASE
        WHEN cash_total > credit_card_total THEN 'cash_withdrawals'
        WHEN credit_card_total > cash_total THEN 'credit_card_withdrawals'
        ELSE 'tie'
    END AS larger_category,
    ABS(cash_total - credit_card_total) AS difference_usd
FROM totals;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(is_woman) > SUM(is_man)  THEN 'women'
    WHEN SUM(is_woman) < SUM(is_man)  THEN 'men'
    ELSE 'equal'

  ABS(SUM(is_woman) - SUM(is_man)) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(birth_number, 3, 2) AS INT) > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_woman,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(birth_number, 3, 2) AS INT) <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_man
  FROM client
  WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'Ostrava - mesto'
  )
) t;
